notes:
I found one pick I can stand behind. Its hours for December 27 to 30, 2026 aren't posted yet, so I left them out.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Mini Mondo, Montréal Science Centre (Old Port of Montréal)",
      "age_fit": "For children under 7",
      "source_name": "Montréal Science Centre"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Age fit:** The "under 7" wording comes from a Museums Montréal listing for the Science Centre's exhibition for young children. That listing is a directory, not the venue's own page, so please check it with the venue. 
For children under 7.

- **Hours for your dates:** I found no Science Centre schedule for 2026. Its holiday page is from last year: 
open 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. December 21 to 22, December 26 to 30 and January 2 to 6, 2025
. It also said the centre was 
closed on December 23, 24, 25 and 31
. That suggests holiday hours are likely, but I can't confirm them for this year.
- **Price:** I left it out. The figures I saw came from third-party sites and disagreed with each other.

**Biodôme (not a pick):** I couldn't get an age range for toddlers from the Biodôme's own page, so I left it out of the picks. The Espace pour la vie hours page shows a pattern of 
Monday closed, Tuesday to Sunday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
 for September. Its December schedule wasn't in what I read. If that pattern holds, Monday, December 28 would be a closed day. Check the Espace pour la vie hours page before you plan around it.

I ran out of searches before I could check other venues, such as the zoo or playgrounds. I didn't want to name anything I hadn't seen on the operator's own page.
